title: The Skeleton Lake of the Himalayas

lines.text: High in the Himalayas lies a frozen lake called Roopkund.
Around it lie hundreds of human skeletons.
A forest ranger found them in 1942.
People believed one storm killed them all.
But in 2019, scientists tested their DNA.
They died in different groups, centuries apart.
Why they all ended up here is still unsolved.
